question: Can one of the three remaining rank49-feasible low-impact heads be removed from the now-stable rank48 support while preserving the same pooled interface in both OOD directions?

prior_art.rank49_deletion: L1H3, L3H7, and L10H5 were each individually removable from the earlier rank49 crossfit program; L1H5 was selected to form rank48.
prior_art.rank48_stability: The rank48 support with one pooled projector passes clean forward/reverse OOD and three 10% source-noise seeds in both directions.

evaluation: For each frozen candidate removal, run the resulting 47-component source graph forward and reverse on row-disjoint temporal-v12/iswas-v11 targets and controls using the exact pooled projector at gain one.

predictions.pred_a_authority_hash_disjointness_finit: All authorities and projector hashes reproduce, fit/evaluation IDs are disjoint, source exchange changes one token, values are finite, and exactly 39 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_rank47_arm_has_bidir: At least one arm has minimum coordinate projection at least 0.75 and mean/worst residual at most 0.20 in both directions.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_one_rank47_arm_has_bidir: The same arm has both task behavior projections at least 0.80 and worst target residual at most 0.15 in both directions.
predictions.pred_d_at_least_one_rank47_arm_is_bidire: The same arm has control margin RMS at most 0.10, median full-vocabulary KL at most 0.02, and zero top-one flips in both directions.
predictions.pred_e_selected_rank47_arm_is_direction_: A jointly feasible arm exists and its paired forward/reverse task behavior projections differ by at most 0.05.

decision: Select the first arm in the frozen order passing every bidirectional gate and freeze its 47-site support. If none passes, retain rank48 and close single-component pruning at this interface.
